review_candidates.title: Network Installer - TELECOM East
review_candidates.description: About Peraton Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world's leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we're keeping people around the world safe and secure. About The Role Shape the Future of U.S. Airspace with Peraton Join Peraton in advancing the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the National Airspace System (NAS) through the FAA's Brand New Air Traffic Control System (BNATCS) program. As a trusted partner to the Federal Aviation Administration, we deliver the cutting-edge systems and services that keep our nation's skies safe, secure, and seamlessly connected. We're seeking forward-thinking professionals who thrive in mission-critical environments and are excited to help transform the future of air traffic management. This is your opportunity to contribute to one of the world's most vital transportation infrastructures-working alongside experts in aviation, engineering, cybersecurity, and systems integration. At Peraton, you won't just support the mission-you'll help define it. Network Installer - Make an Impact Where It Matters Most We are looking for a Network Installer to join our talented and diverse team supporting the FAA. In this role, you'll play a key part in maintaining and enhancing the network infrastructure behind mission-critical aviation systems. You'll ensure the reliability, performance, and security of IP-based networks that support air traffic operations-gaining valuable experience in federal programs while contributing to highly visible national initiatives. What You'll Do Ensure the uptime, performance, and security of FAA network infrastructure Install, configure, and maintain routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless systems support SD-WAN solutions across distributed environments Install, terminate, and test fiber optic cabling (single-mode and multi-mode) Perform fiber testing using OTDR and certification tools Monitor systems daily, analyze logs, and respond to incidents Troubleshoot network issues across fiber, SD-WAN, and IP layers, escalating as needed Support network cutovers, migrations, and failover validation Maintain accurate network diagrams, documentation, and configuration records Why This Role Matters The FAA is at the heart of aviation safety and innovation. In this role, your work directly supports the systems that enable safe and efficient air travel for millions of passengers every day. By ensuring network reliability and rapidly resolving issues, you'll play a critical role in maintaining the communications and technologies that keep aircraft moving safely across the nation's airspace. Why Peraton: At Peraton, you won't just support the mission-you'll define it . Your work will directly impact the safety, efficiency, and modernization of the nation's airspace. Here, innovation, expertise, and dedication are recognized and celebrated. Travel and Work Location Requirements This position requires 100% local travel to Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) facilities within the assigned region. Candidates must reside in or near Jamaica, NY and be able to travel regularly to multiple FAA sites throughout their designated area as business needs require. Make your mark where it matters most-join Peraton and help shape the future of aviation Qualifications Position Requirements: U.S. Citizenship required with the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance Bachelor's degree with 8+ years of experience (or equivalent combination: Master's 6+, Associate's 10+, HS diploma 12+) Proven experience managing and supporting enterprise network environments Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP) Hands-on experience with Cisco, Juniper, or similar networking technologies Experience with TDM-to-IP migrations and modern IP-based networking Solid understanding of SD-WAN, fiber optics, and wireless LAN/WAN technologies Familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and network monitoring tools (e.g., SolarWinds, Nagios) Ability to read and interpret network diagrams and schematics Experience with fiber testing tools (e.g., OTDR) Demonstrated leadership and team collaboration skills Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting FAA or National Airspace System (NAS) environments Knowledge of federal network standards, compliance, and security frameworks Background supporting FAA, DOT, DHS, or DoD programs Relevant certifications (e.g., CCNA, CCNP, CompTIA Network+, Juniper JNCIA/JNCIS, BICSI) Familiarity with FAA NextGen or air traffic control modernization initiatives Experience working on large-scale infrastructure or transformation programs #TDM-IP Details Target Salary Range: $104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual's experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. Benefits Statement: Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits. Application Statements: The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate's own. EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Core Network Lead, Run Team based in Germany. We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Core Network Lead to oversee the performance, reliability, and continuous operation of a global Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) infrastructure. In this fully remote leadership role, you will manage a multidisciplinary team of engineers, QA specialists, and Site Reliability Engineers responsible for the complete mobile core network lifecycle. You will ensure the stability and scalability of critical telecommunications services, covering mobile data, voice, VoLTE, and SMS across multiple international markets. Working closely with engineering, infrastructure, and external technology partners, you will drive operational excellence, service availability, and technical readiness. You will also establish robust monitoring, automation, configuration management, and incident response practices to maintain exceptional service standards. This is an opportunity to combine deep telecommunications expertise with technical leadership in a fast-growing, globally distributed technology environment. Accountabilities Technical Team Leadership: Lead, mentor, and manage a team of seven engineers, QA specialists, and Site Reliability Engineers responsible for the operation and maintenance of the global Mobile Core Network. People and Performance Management: Oversee team planning, sprint management, workload distribution, prioritization, and stakeholder communication. Conduct regular one-to-one meetings, provide constructive feedback, deliver fair and evidence-based performance reviews, and support individual career development. Mobile Core Network Operations: Manage the end-to-end Mobile Core Network infrastructure, including Cloud-Native Network Functions (CNFs) and Virtual Network Functions (VNFs), covering subscriber databases (HSS/HLR), packet core, signalling systems, voice services, and messaging platforms. Network Performance and Availability: Take ownership of network reliability and ensure the achievement of a 99.98% annual service uptime target. Define, monitor, and report key performance indicators covering availability, attach and session success rates, call and SMS success rates, latency, packet loss, and resource utilization. Monitoring and Incident Management: Establish effective observability, monitoring, and proactive alerting practices. Implement preventive measures such as geographic redundancy, capacity forecasting, failover testing, post-incident reviews, and problem management. Configuration and Change Management: Own configuration management as a core operational discipline, ensuring version-controlled configurations, structured change control, automated deployment and rollback procedures, and configuration drift detection across network functions and environments. Service Readiness and Technical Handover: Collaborate with Build Teams to transition newly developed or integrated systems into live operations. Define operational readiness criteria, establish technical handover standards, and ensure all accepted systems are properly documented, tested, and supported. Partner and Supplier Coordination: Work closely with Network Equipment Providers (NEPs), IPX/GRX partners, Infrastructure-as-a-Service providers, managed service providers, and SaaS vendors to ensure end-to-end service quality and operational continuity. Engineering Standards and Automation: Establish engineering best practices, automated testing strategies, operational procedures, and technical documentation standards to improve efficiency and reduce service risks. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to strengthen network architecture, improve operational processes, optimize capacity, and enhance the reliability and scalability of telecommunications services. Requirements At least 5 years of hands-on professional experience working with mobile core networks. At least 2 years of experience leading engineering teams, QA specialists, or technical professionals in an Agile or delivery-focused environment. Strong technical knowledge of packet core and voice core technologies, including subscriber databases such as HSS/HLR, policy and charging systems, VoLTE, and legacy circuit-switched voice. Extensive understanding of telecommunications signalling protocols and architectures, particularly Diameter, SS7, and SIP. Experience with messaging architectures and SMS routing, including interconnection and interoperability with other mobile network operators. Strong understanding of mobile network operations, service availability, incident management, and performance optimization. Experience managing multiple concurrent technical delivery or rollout initiatives while maintaining clear priorities and effective communication. Ability to establish operational processes, engineering standards, and comprehensive technical documentation that support reliable system handovers. Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to motivate technical teams, develop talent, and maintain accountability. Excellent analytical and troubleshooting capabilities, with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving complex network issues. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across geographically distributed teams and external partners. Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken, as it is the primary working language. Nice to have: Experience with automation technologies, including CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, Terraform, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes, or automated signalling test frameworks. Practical experience with major MVNO and mobile core technology vendors such as Nokia, Ericsson, Mavenir, Oracle Communications, Cisco, Summa Networks, NetNumber, or XIUS. Familiarity with cloud-native or virtualized network functions deployed on AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform, or private cloud environments. A bachelor's or master's degree in Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Germany-Based Salary: The applicable compensation range will depend on the employing location and will be discussed during the initial recruitment conversation. Permanent Full-Time Position: Long-term employment opportunity within an international technology organization. Global Collaboration: Work alongside a diverse, distributed team of professionals across more than 60 countries. Leadership Opportunities: Take ownership of a specialized technical team and influence operational standards, network strategy, and engineering practices. Professional Development: Access opportunities to expand your technical expertise, develop leadership capabilities, and take on new challenges as the organization grows. Autonomy and Ownership: Benefit from a trust-based working culture with clear responsibilities, minimal bureaucracy, and freedom to drive meaningful improvements.
